question: AMD Datacenter Candidate: MI300X. 192GB HBM3, ~5.3 TB/s BW. Price ~$15,000-$20,000 USD. Offers competitive bandwidth-to-price ratio compared to H100/H200. Requires ROCm software stack compatibility check for Qwen3.
